## Scraper / feed modules (first docstring paragraph)

| module | role |
|---|---|
| `scrapers.py` | Scrapers - honest v3.2 rewrite. |
| `stats.py` | Minor-league stats fetcher. |
| `tjstats.py` | tjstats.py - scraper for TJStats (Thomas Nestico) Top-100 MLB Prospects. |
| `spotrac.py` | Spotrac international-signings scraper. |
| `fangraphs_csv.py` | Auto-ingest FanGraphs board CSV exports - v3, four-CSV report sets. |
| `college_stats.py` | NCAA Division-I college box scores for draft prospects (stats.ncaa.org). |
| `draft_stats.py` | FG player-page stats scraper for DRAFT (college + HS) prospects. |
| `draft_csv.py` | Draft prospect CSV ingest - mirror of fangraphs_csv.py for amateurs. |
| `overseas_stats.py` | FG player-page stats scraper for overseas prospects. |
| `overseas_csv.py` | Overseas (KBO/NPB/CPBL) CSV ingest - mirror of draft_csv.py. |
| `intl_amateur.py` | International-amateur FV routing (owner directive 2026-06-12). |
| `mlbam_ingest.py` | mlbam_ingest.py - MLBAM-ID-anchored prospect discovery. |
| `statcast_metrics.py` | MiLB Statcast-style pitch movement and contact-quality aggregates. |
| `mlb_leverage.py` | Self-computed reliever leverage + win-probability, from MLB's own feed. |
| `fielding_positions.py` | Game-data positional versatility ("versa"). |
| `headshots.py` | headshots.py - maximize prospect-photo coverage via a validated CDN fallback. |
| `player_images.py` | Image-URL helpers for the Draft + Overseas sections. |
| `player_news.py` | Fetch and normalize player-news snippets for the static site. |
| `source_articles.py` | (no module docstring) |
| `feed_cache.py` | Shared, game_pk-keyed cache for MLB Stats API `/feed/live` payloads. |
| `swing_plus_ingest.py` | Swing+ ingestion - scores MLB bat-tracking swings through Will Cahoon's Swing+ model and writes the platform sidecar. |
| `milb_history.py` | League-wide season stats from the MLB StatsAPI, cached to disk - the historical level/rate source the local DB never had. |
| `staff_ingest.py` | Staff history ingest from the MLB StatsAPI coaches endpoint (Staff Gems stages 0 and 1: the fetch half and the parse half). |

## Source freshness risks (curated)

Hand-maintained; the generator round-trips this block verbatim. Edit freely
between the sentinels.

- FanGraphs: Cloudflare-blocks scripted Python fetches, so board/article
  ingestion is WebFetch-only plus manual CSV drops staged by step 0b
  (`fangraphs_csv.py`). Deep-tier article grades are unreliable; "Other
  Prospects of Note" maps to FV 30 by owner rule (2026-06-18).
- MLB StatsAPI is the load-bearing dependency: ids, transactions, IL,
  rosters, stats, fielding, and the self-computed leverage feed
  (`mlb_leverage.py` reads winProbability because FanGraphs gmLI is
  unreachable). No auth, but any schema or availability change breaks the
  daily path first.
- MLB StatsAPI for the MLB Scores job (`tools/scores_job.py`, behind
  `scores_core.SCORES_LIVE`, on from the SCORES_5a flip of 2026-10-07; the
  public page has files once the box job is installed, deploy/WEBMASTER.md
  section 10): every payload carries StatsAPI's
  terms line, verbatim: "Copyright 2026 MLB Advanced Media, L.P.  Use of any
  content on this page acknowledges agreement to the terms posted here
  http://gdx.mlb.com/components/copyright.txt" (that page reads "Only
  individual, non-commercial, non-bulk use of the Materials is permitted").
  Owner answer SC-TERMS (a), 2026-09-30: the scores job as planned, republishing
  from our own files with that line and MLB's credit on every payload.
- MLB's highlight video on the Scores page (SCORES_4a, behind
  `scores_core.SCORES_LIVE`): owner answer SC-VIDEO (a), 2026-09-30, MLB's own
  embed player, a frame from streamable.com/m/<slug>, the embed URL MLB's clip
  pages name (checked on five clips of two finals on 2026-10-07). The job
  stores per clip that URL, two poster URLs on img.mlbstatic.com and the
  MLB.com page; no video, caption or poster byte is stored or proxied. MLB's
  player runs its own ads (a pre-roll played in the 2026-10-07 hand check).
  Kill switch: EMBED_OFF or EEPHUS_SCORES_EMBED=0 (deploy/WEBMASTER.md 10).
- Baseball Savant CSV pulls are disk-cached (`feed_cache.py`); caches can go
  stale silently between forced refreshes, and minors Statcast coverage only
  starts 2023. Use --force to bypass the cache.
- `data/positions_played.json` refreshes on the MONTHLY cadence only:
  run_monthly step 3a-ii calls `fielding_positions.build_positions_played`,
  gated by --skip-stats (default runs). `run_daily()` never calls it, so
  mid-month position changes wait for the next monthly run (F-09 resolution,
  2026-07-01).
- Spotrac (IFA bonuses + contracts) is scraped on the monthly path,
  best-effort: a layout change fails soft and leaves the prior cache.
- TJStats and MLB Pipeline live boards are captured daily point-in-time;
  their histories are append-only and cannot be backfilled.
- Baseball-Reference war_daily (via pybaseball) is the run frame under the
  served eWAR (`war_source.py`). The whole WAR basis rests on that one file;
  a schema or availability change there moves every WAR the site prints.
- The Odds API (`betting_ingest.py`) runs on the free tier, 500 credits a
  month: the open and close snapshots cost 3 credits each, about 186 a month.
  Props are priced per event and armed separately (EEPHUS_PROPS_CREDITS).
  Display terms for the served prices are an open owner review item.
- Open-Meteo (`betting_weather.py`) is captured nightly, keyless, on the free
  endpoint, whose terms are non-commercial only and name subscription sites
  as commercial; the data is CC BY 4.0 with attribution required. Setting the
  key variable moves the capture to the commercial endpoint. Owner review item
  before any paid Diamond tier.
- MLB Trade Rumors (`tools/ingest_arbitration_ledger.py`) is a hand-run,
  permanently cached, rate-limited ingest (MLBTR firewalls rapid requests),
  never on the pipeline. Its ledger is a lab file at
  `data/_labs/arb_ledger.json`, which ships in neither deploy consumer, so
  the projection and tracker entries are not republished (owner answer
  M23-3, 2026-09-25). MLBTR keeps its /sources/ credit as a comparator.
- The pitcher BMI driver's bio panel (`data/_frozen/arch_bio_panel.json`,
  read by `efv_drivers.load_bio_panel`) is a frozen input with no producer:
  its builder, the archetype lab script `tools/_arch_bio_panel.py`, was
  deleted in 8fecb2f5, so board listings newer than the committed file
  (017d3bc2, 2026-07-29) never reach it. It ships in neither deploy consumer.
